comparison.objective: Refit a spring-plunger window screen into top and bottom channels; candidate tunes an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual large-frame lifting, plunger compression, swinging and channel seating versus fine tool use and iterative force-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Screen must be fitted, centered, planar, still and released without dropping or forcing the frame; candidate instead passes through bounded repeated impacts.
comparison.reason: Spring compression is generic; the record tests constrained large-frame insertion rather than commissioning a dissipative mechanism.
